source_requirement: SRC-MAC signed INT8 operands and INT32 accumulator
stimulus: Signed minimum/maximum; zero; positive/negative products; directed and seeded random streams
reference_or_check: Independent C++ predictor from observed input events; compare exact 32-bit output by event ID
coverage: Operand sign/extreme/zero bins during enable; observed result signs
pass_criterion: Every observed event matches; nonzero comparisons; no pending or unexpected result
assumptions: ONBOARDING project only; Real pe_mac only; no handshake or pipeline assumed

source_requirement: SRC-MAC clear before enable and disabled hold

coverage: Observed clear x enable; hold and clear events
pass_criterion: Clear wins; disabled uncleared accumulator holds; no relevant X/Z or assertion failures
assumptions: ONBOARDING project only; Do not infer arithmetic completion from a sequencer item

source_requirement: SRC-MAC asynchronous active-low reset

assumptions: ONBOARDING project only; MAC has no accepted external memory transfers

source_requirement: SRC-MAC 32-bit wrap overflow
